verdict.rationale: Keycloak's docs describe role-based authorization enforced through OIDC/OAuth2 tokens (access tokens carry roles/claims), fine-grained authorization services for policy-based permissions, admin console/REST API for defining roles, and endpoints for token introspection/validation that surface claims for authorization checks. Community reports corroborate long-term production use for SSO/authorization across many services. missing for 10: no explicit documentation snippet showing role claims embedded in JWT structure, and no independent hands-on test confirming token claim enforcement mechanics.
